latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Web Dashboard Optimizer:

- Provides templates and best practices for building smooth, stable web monitoring dashboards.
- Features smart data refresh (updates only on change) and scroll position retention.
- Optimizes modal (popup) interactions and adds automatic service restart support.
- Includes responsive design for mobile compatibility.
- Ideal for task monitoring, data visualization, real-time panels, and admin interfaces.
